questions.question: The pattern adds 4 each time: 7, 11, 15, 19. What is next?
questions.explanation: Each term is 4 more than the term before it.

questions.question: A sequence doubles: 3, 6, 12, 24. Which number comes next?
questions.explanation: Doubling 24 gives 48.

questions.question: The symbols repeat ▲, ○, ○, □. Which symbol is in position 10?
questions.explanation: Position 10 is the second symbol in the repeating four-symbol group.

questions.question: Start at C and move forward 4 letters. Which letter do you reach?
questions.explanation: D, E, F, G are the four steps after C.

questions.question: Which letter is exactly halfway between H and N?
questions.explanation: I, J, K, L, M, N; K is the middle letter.

questions.question: Bird is to nest as bee is to ____.
questions.explanation: A nest is a bird's home; a hive is a bee's home.

questions.question: A calendar is used to find dates. A clock is used to find ____.
questions.explanation: A clock tells the time.

questions.question: Which one does not belong with the others?
questions.explanation: A cube is a solid; the other three are flat shapes.

questions.question: Choose the odd one out: 12, 18, 24, 25.
questions.explanation: 12, 18 and 24 are even; 25 is odd.

questions.question: In a code, each letter changes to the next letter. If CAT becomes DBU, how is SUN written?
questions.explanation: Move S to T, U to V and N to O.

questions.question: If MAP becomes NBQ by moving each letter one step forward, how is PEN written?
questions.explanation: P→Q, E→F and N→O.

questions.question: Seven children stand in a line. Ria is fourth from the left. What position is she from the right?
Aarav is taller than Dev. Dev is taller than Kabir. Who is shortest?
questions.explanation: Aarav > Dev > Kabir, so Kabir is shortest.

questions.question: There are 9 runners. Meera finishes immediately after the runner in 5th place. What is her position?
questions.explanation: Immediately after fifth place is sixth place.

questions.question: If today is Tuesday, what day will it be 3 days later?
questions.explanation: Wednesday is one day later, Thursday two, Friday three.

questions.question: The 1st day of a month is Monday. What day is the 8th day?
questions.explanation: Seven days make one week, so the same weekday returns on the 8th.

questions.question: A child has 3 shirts and 2 pairs of shorts. How many outfits can be made?
questions.explanation: Each shirt pairs with either pair of shorts: 3 × 2 = 6.

questions.question: A snack box offers 2 fruits and 3 drinks. How many fruit-and-drink pairs are possible?
questions.explanation: 2 choices for fruit × 3 choices for drink = 6.

questions.question: A row shows ○, ○, △, ○, ○, △. Which group comes next?
questions.explanation: The three-symbol group repeats as circle, circle, triangle.

questions.question: A sequence of flat shapes has 3, 4 and 5 straight sides. Which shape comes next?
questions.explanation: The number of sides increases by one: 3, 4, 5, then 6. A six-sided flat shape is a hexagon.

questions.question: Which capital letter has vertical mirror symmetry in standard block lettering?
questions.explanation: A has matching left and right halves along a vertical line.

questions.question: Which pair of capital letters both have vertical mirror symmetry?
questions.explanation: A and M have matching left and right halves in standard block lettering.

questions.question: A shape has 4 equal straight sides and 4 corners. Which shape is it?
questions.explanation: A square has four equal sides and four corners.

questions.question: A large rectangle is divided by one vertical and one horizontal line through its centre. How many small rectangles are formed?
questions.explanation: The two lines divide the large rectangle into four smaller rectangles.

questions.question: Three digits are available: 1, 2 and 3. How many two-digit numbers can be made without repeating a digit?
questions.explanation: There are 3 choices for the tens place and 2 for the ones place: 3 × 2 = 6.

questions.question: Find the missing number: 2, 5, 9, 14, __.
questions.explanation: The increases are 3, 4, 5, then 6; 14 + 6 = 20.

questions.question: Hand is to glove as foot is to ____.
questions.explanation: A glove is worn on a hand; a sock is worn on a foot.

questions.question: Which number is different: 16, 25, 36, 42?
questions.explanation: 16, 25 and 36 are square numbers; 42 is not.

questions.question: If every digit is replaced by the next digit, 246 becomes 357. What does 508 become?
questions.explanation: Add one to each digit: 5→6, 0→1 and 8→9.

questions.question: In a queue, Nila is 3rd from the front and 5th from the back. How many children are there?
questions.explanation: 3 + 5 − 1 = 7 because Nila is counted from both ends.

questions.question: Which group contains only shapes with curved boundaries?
questions.explanation: A circle and an oval have curved boundaries.

questions.question: A school week starts on Monday. What is the fifth school day?
questions.explanation: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday.

questions.question: Which letter comes two places before P?
questions.explanation: O is one place before P and N is two places before P.

questions.question: A pattern has 2 dots, then 4 dots, then 6 dots. How many dots are in the next group?
questions.explanation: The number of dots increases by 2 each time.

questions.question: A square is drawn inside a larger square with the same centre and parallel sides. How many squares can you see, including the outer one?
questions.explanation: There is one inner square and one outer square.

questions.question: A code uses one shape (circle or triangle) followed by one colour (red, blue or green). How many codes are possible?
questions.explanation: Two shapes × three colours = six codes.

questions.question: What comes next in the pattern 5, 10, 15, 20, __?
questions.explanation: The pattern adds 5 each time.

questions.question: Which one is not a measuring unit?
questions.explanation: Metre, kilogram and litre are units; triangle is a shape.

questions.question: Shoe is to foot as cap is to ____.
questions.explanation: A shoe is worn on the foot; a cap is worn on the head.

questions.question: Five children stand in a line. Sam is second from the left. How many children are before Sam?
questions.explanation: Only the first child stands before the second child.

questions.question: Which pair has the same number of corners?
questions.explanation: Each triangle has three corners.

questions.question: If A is coded as B and B as C, how is C coded?
questions.explanation: Move one letter forward in the alphabet.

questions.question: Which flat shape has no straight sides and no corners?
questions.explanation: A circle is curved all the way around.

questions.question: A big square is split into two equal rectangles by one line. How many rectangles are there in total?
questions.explanation: There are two small rectangles and the large outside rectangle.

questions.question: Which number is missing: 2, 4, __, 8, 10?
questions.explanation: The sequence counts forward by twos.

questions.question: Which unit is best for measuring the length of a pencil?
questions.explanation: A pencil is a short length, so centimetres are suitable.

questions.question: Which item is different from the others?
questions.explanation: Apple, banana and orange are fruits; a spoon is not.

questions.question: Day is to night as light is to ____.
questions.explanation: Day and night are opposites, as are light and dark.

questions.question: Maya is taller than Tara. Tara is taller than Ritu. Who is in the middle by height?
questions.explanation: Maya is tallest, Ritu shortest, so Tara is in the middle.

questions.question: Which group shows a repeating pair?
questions.explanation: Circle and triangle alternate in the same order.

questions.question: If 1 means A, 2 means B and 3 means C, what does 2-1 spell?
questions.explanation: 2 is B and 1 is A, so the code spells BA.

questions.question: Which is heavier: 1 kilogram of rice or 1 kilogram of flour?
questions.explanation: Both amounts have a mass of one kilogram.

questions.question: Which solid shape can roll easily because it has a curved surface all around?
questions.explanation: A sphere has a curved surface all around.

questions.question: A pattern uses one star, then two stars, then one star, then two stars. What comes next?
questions.explanation: The one-star, two-star pattern repeats.

questions.question: Which letter comes immediately after G?
questions.explanation: H follows G in the alphabet.

questions.question: Which number is odd?
questions.explanation: 17 cannot be divided into two equal whole-number groups.

questions.question: A child can choose one of 2 caps and one of 2 bags. How many pairs are possible?
questions.explanation: There are 2 cap choices for each of 2 bags: 2 × 2 = 4.

questions.question: If today is Saturday, what day is tomorrow?
questions.explanation: Sunday is the day after Saturday.

questions.question: Which pair is made of two shapes with four corners each?
questions.explanation: A square and a rectangle each have four corners.

questions.question: A number pattern counts backwards by 2: 14, 12, 10, __. What comes next?
questions.explanation: Subtract 2 from 10 to get 8.

questions.question: Continue the number chain 1, 4, 10, 19, 31, __.
questions.explanation: The gaps are 3, 6, 9, 12 and then 15; 31 + 15 = 46.

questions.question: In the alphabet, what letter is three places after W?
questions.explanation: X is one place after W, Y two places after W and Z three places after W.

questions.question: Thermometer is to temperature as weighing scale is to ____.
questions.explanation: A thermometer measures temperature; a weighing scale measures weight.

questions.question: Which number is not a multiple of 8: 24, 32, 40 or 45?
questions.explanation: 24, 32 and 40 are multiples of 8; 45 is not.

questions.question: In a line of 13 pupils, Arjun is seventh from the left. Which position is he from the right?
questions.explanation: 13 − 7 + 1 = 7, so he is seventh from the right.

questions.question: A lunch order offers 3 sandwiches and 3 juices. How many different sandwich-and-juice pairs are possible?
questions.explanation: There are 3 choices of sandwich for each of 3 juices: 3 × 3 = 9.

questions.question: Which number completes the pattern 9, 18, 27, 36, __?
questions.explanation: The pattern adds 9 each time.

questions.question: Which unit would you use to measure the mass of a school bag?
questions.explanation: A school bag has mass, which is commonly measured in kilograms.

questions.question: Which shape has four straight sides and four corners, with opposite sides equal?
questions.explanation: A rectangle has four sides and opposite sides equal.

questions.question: If each letter is replaced by the next letter, how is SUN coded?
questions.explanation: S moves to T, U to V and N to O.

questions.question: What is the greatest number made using 2, 0 and 7 once each?
questions.explanation: Place the largest digit in the hundreds place.

questions.question: In 583, what is the value of the digit 8?
questions.explanation: 8 is in the tens place, so its value is 80.

questions.question: Which expanded form matches 538?
questions.explanation: 538 has 5 hundreds, 3 tens and 8 ones.

questions.question: Estimate 198 + 203 by rounding to the nearest hundred.
questions.explanation: 198 is about 200 and 203 is about 200.

questions.question: A cake has 8 equal slices. Sam eats 2 slices. What fraction of the whole cake did Sam eat?
questions.explanation: Sam ate 2 of 8 equal slices: 2/8 is the same as 1/4, or one-quarter.

questions.question: A triangular road sign has an outline shaped like a triangle. How many straight sides does that outline have?
questions.explanation: A triangle has 3 straight sides.

questions.question: Which solid shape is most like a die?
questions.explanation: A standard die is shaped like a cube.

questions.question: A pictograph shows 4 stars for birds. If each star means 2 birds, how many birds were counted?
questions.explanation: 4 × 2 = 8 birds.

questions.question: Which number is made by 3 thousands, 4 hundreds, 0 tens and 8 ones?
What is the value of the digit 7 in 5,742?
questions.explanation: The 7 is in the hundreds place, so its value is 700.

questions.question: Which number is written as three thousand and sixty-two?
questions.explanation: Three thousand and sixty-two is 3,062.

questions.question: Arrange 4,105, 4,501 and 4,150 from greatest to smallest.
questions.explanation: Compare hundreds first, then tens to order the last two.

questions.question: Calculate the sum of 2,346 and 1,208.
What is 4,000 − 1,675?
questions.explanation: 4,000 − 1,600 = 2,400; subtract another 75 to get 2,325.

questions.question: Which number makes this true: 268 + __ = 500?
A multiplication fact is 7 × 8. What is the product?
questions.explanation: Seven groups of eight make 56.

questions.question: A rectangle is divided into 4 equal parts. Three parts are shaded. Which fraction is shaded?
questions.explanation: Three of the four equal parts are shaded.

questions.question: Which fraction is equal to one-half?
questions.explanation: Two out of four equal parts make one-half.

questions.question: A ribbon is divided into 8 equal pieces. What fraction is one piece?
questions.explanation: One piece out of eight equal pieces is one-eighth.

questions.question: A rope is 2 m 35 cm long. How many centimetres is that?
questions.explanation: 2 metres are 200 centimetres; 200 + 35 = 235 cm.

questions.question: Which is equal to 3 kilograms?
questions.explanation: One kilogram is 1,000 grams, so 3 kg = 3,000 grams.

questions.question: A bottle holds 750 mL. How much more is needed to make 1 litre?
The temperature rises from 18°C to 25°C. By how many degrees did it rise?
questions.explanation: 25 − 18 = 7 degrees Celsius.

questions.question: How many minutes are there in 2 hours and 15 minutes?
questions.explanation: Two hours are 120 minutes; 120 + 15 = 135 minutes.

questions.question: A notebook costs ₹27 and a pen costs ₹16. What is the total cost?
How many right angles does a rectangle have?
questions.explanation: Each of the four corners of a rectangle is a right angle.

questions.question: A pictograph has 5 symbols. Each symbol represents 4 children. How many children are shown?
questions.explanation: Five groups of four make 20 children.

questions.question: Which number is 100 less than 6,020?
A number is multiplied by 4 to give 84. What was the number?
questions.explanation: 84 divided by 4 is 21.

questions.question: A pizza is cut into 8 equal slices. 4 slices are eaten. What fraction remains?
questions.explanation: Eight slices minus four eaten leaves four of the eight slices.

questions.question: A shape has 5 straight sides. What is it called?
questions.explanation: A pentagon has five sides.

questions.question: Four teams score 12, 17, 9 and 14 points. What is the difference between the highest and lowest scores?
questions.explanation: The highest is 17 and the lowest is 9; 17 − 9 = 8.

questions.question: A jug contains 1 litre 250 mL. How many millilitres is that?
questions.explanation: 1 litre is 1,000 mL; add 250 mL.

questions.question: A clock shows 7:45. How many minutes remain until 8:00?
questions.explanation: From 7:45 to 8:00 is 15 minutes.

questions.question: A toy costs ₹86. You pay with ₹100. How much change should you receive?
Which is the correct expanded form of 4,309?
questions.explanation: The thousands, hundreds, tens and ones are 4, 3, 0 and 9.

questions.question: What is the value of 6 in 364?
questions.explanation: The digit 6 is in the tens place.

questions.question: Which number is written as two hundred and seven?
questions.explanation: Two hundred and seven is 207.

questions.question: Which is the greatest number: 409, 490 or 404?
questions.explanation: All have 4 hundreds; 490 has the most tens.

questions.question: Add 235 and 142.
Subtract 268 from 500.
What comes next: 12, 16, 20, 24, __?
questions.explanation: Add 4 each time.

questions.question: A pencil is 18 cm long. Another is 7 cm longer. How long is the second pencil?
A bag weighs 2 kg. A smaller bag weighs 1 kg. What is their total weight?
questions.explanation: 2 kg + 1 kg = 3 kg.

questions.question: Two bottles each hold 500 mL. How much do they hold altogether?
questions.explanation: 500 mL + 500 mL = 1,000 mL, which is 1 litre.

questions.question: How many minutes are there in half an hour?
questions.explanation: Half of 60 minutes is 30 minutes.

questions.question: The morning temperature is 20°C and the afternoon temperature is 27°C. How much warmer is the afternoon?
questions.explanation: 27 − 20 = 7 degrees.

questions.question: A pencil costs ₹8 and an eraser costs ₹5. What is the total?
How many straight sides does a rectangle have?
questions.explanation: A rectangle has four straight sides.

questions.question: Which solid has two flat circular faces and one curved surface?
questions.explanation: A cylinder has two circular flat faces and one curved surface.

questions.question: A picture stands for 2 flowers. What do 5 pictures represent?
questions.explanation: Five pictures represent 5 × 2 = 10 flowers.

questions.question: What is 10 more than 286?
questions.explanation: Adding one ten changes 286 to 296.

questions.question: There are 4 groups of 5 buttons. How many buttons are there?
questions.explanation: 4 groups of 5 make 20.

questions.question: A shape pattern goes circle, square, circle, square. What is the 7th shape?
questions.explanation: Odd-numbered positions are circles.

questions.question: How many centimetres are in 1 metre?
questions.explanation: One metre equals 100 centimetres.

questions.question: Which unit is best to measure the weight of a watermelon?
questions.explanation: A watermelon is heavy enough to measure in kilograms.

questions.question: A class starts at 10:00 and ends at 10:30. How long is the class?
questions.explanation: 10:00 to 10:30 is 30 minutes.

questions.question: You have ₹50 and spend ₹32. How much is left?
A chart shows 3 stars for 6 birds. What does one star represent?
questions.explanation: 6 birds divided equally among 3 stars gives 2 birds per star.

questions.question: Which shape has no corners?
questions.explanation: A circle has no corners.

questions.question: Which number has 6 thousands, 2 hundreds, 4 tens and 9 ones?
questions.explanation: The place values make 6,000 + 200 + 40 + 9 = 6,249.

questions.question: Which is the number name for 7,015?
options: Seven thousand one hundred and five
questions.explanation: 7,015 has seven thousands, no hundreds, one ten and five ones.

questions.question: Find the missing number: 1,875 + __ = 2,500.
A shape is split into 6 equal parts. Five parts are shaded. Which fraction is not shaded?
questions.explanation: One of the six equal parts is not shaded, so the fraction is 1/6.

questions.question: A triangle has sides of 5 cm, 5 cm and 7 cm. What is its perimeter?
A chart shows 8 votes for red, 13 for blue and 9 for green. How many more votes does blue receive than red?
questions.explanation: 13 − 8 = 5 votes.

questions.question: Which is the smallest number that can be made with the digits 5, 0 and 8, using each once?
questions.explanation: A three-digit number cannot begin with zero; 5 is the smallest possible hundreds digit.

questions.question: A class collects 145 shells and then 126 more. How many shells does it have?
Two erasers cost ₹8 each. What is their total cost?
Which solid shape has six equal square faces?
questions.explanation: A cube has six faces, and each face is a square.

questions.question: A bus travels 38 km in the morning and 27 km in the afternoon. Total distance?
Four children each receive 3 rakhis. How many rakhis are given out?
Two children measure the same desk with hand spans. Why might their counts differ?
options: A hand span is always one metre
Their hand spans may be different sizes
questions.explanation: Informal units vary with the person measuring, so counts may differ.

questions.question: How many half-litre bottles hold 1 litre altogether?
questions.explanation: Two half-litres make one litre; 1 litre need 2 half-litre bottles.

questions.question: A child has ₹100 and buys a toy for ₹67. How much remains?
A movie starts at 2:00 and lasts 90 minutes. When does it end?
questions.explanation: 90 minutes is 1 hour 30 minutes.

questions.question: A survey records 14 children choosing cricket and 11 choosing football. How many children chose either sport altogether?
questions.explanation: 14 + 11 = 25 children.

questions.question: Which action is a good way to test whether a paper shape is symmetric?
options: Fold it along a possible symmetry line
questions.explanation: A fold test shows whether the two halves match.

questions.question: A school collects 1,245 bottle caps on Monday and 1,376 on Tuesday. How many caps are collected?
A library had 2,000 books. It lent 485 books. How many stayed in the library?
A family buys 3 notebooks at ₹28 each. What is the total cost?
A lunch box costs ₹145 and a water bottle costs ₹86. How much do they cost together?
A ribbon is 3 m 40 cm long. Another is 2 m 25 cm long. What is the combined length?
questions.explanation: 3 m 40 cm + 2 m 25 cm = 5 m 65 cm.

questions.question: A tailor has 5 metres of cloth and uses 2 metres 75 centimetres. How much cloth remains?
questions.explanation: 5 m 00 cm − 2 m 75 cm = 2 m 25 cm.

questions.question: A fruit seller has 2 kg 500 g of apples and 1 kg 750 g of oranges. What is the total weight?
A water tank contains 8 litres. The family uses 3 litres 500 mL. How much water remains?
questions.explanation: 8 litres − 3 litres 500 mL = 4 litres 500 mL.

questions.question: At noon it is 31°C. By evening it falls by 6°C. What is the evening temperature?
questions.explanation: 31 − 6 = 25 degrees Celsius.

questions.question: A bus leaves at 8:35 a.m. and reaches at 9:20 a.m. How long is the journey?
questions.explanation: From 8:35 to 9:00 is 25 minutes; then 20 more minutes: 45 minutes.

questions.question: A sports class lasts 1 hour 20 minutes. How many minutes is that?
questions.explanation: 60 + 20 = 80 minutes.

questions.question: A cake has 12 equal pieces. The family eats one-third of it. How many pieces are eaten?
questions.explanation: One-third of 12 is 12 ÷ 3 = 4 pieces.

questions.question: A school bus carries 28 children in the morning and 31 in the afternoon. How many child-trips are recorded?
A square garden has a side of 6 metres. What is its perimeter?
questions.explanation: A square has four equal sides: 4 × 6 = 24 m.

questions.question: A museum has 1,250 visitors on Saturday and 1,475 on Sunday. How many visitors came over the weekend?
A shop packs 8 boxes with 6 crayons in each. How many crayons are packed?
questions.explanation: 8 × 6 = 48 crayons.

questions.question: A child saves ₹35 each week for 4 weeks. How much is saved?
A recipe needs 250 mL of milk for one batch. How much milk is needed for 4 batches?
A walking track is 400 m long. Rohan walks 3 complete rounds. How far does he walk?
A cartoon begins at 5:40 p.m. and lasts 35 minutes. When does it finish?
questions.explanation: 5:40 + 20 minutes = 6:00; add 15 minutes = 6:15.

questions.question: A parcel weighs 1 kg 250 g. A second parcel weighs 750 g. What is their combined weight?
A class survey has 18 votes for football, 12 for cricket and 9 for badminton. How many votes were counted?
A 1-metre strip is divided into 4 equal pieces. What length is each piece?
questions.explanation: 100 cm divided by 4 is 25 cm.

questions.question: A school orders 1,008 pencils and then 992 more. How many pencils arrive?
Two storybooks cost ₹68 each. What is the total bill?
A farmer arranges 9 rows of 7 plants. How many plants are there?
questions.explanation: 9 groups of 7 make 63.

questions.question: A train journey takes 2 hours 35 minutes. How many minutes is the journey?
questions.explanation: 2 hours are 120 minutes; 120 + 35 = 155 minutes.

questions.question: A bottle has 1 litre 500 mL of juice. Four children share it equally. How much does each receive?
A class has 125 red beads and 132 blue beads. How many beads are there?
There are 300 paper sheets. The class uses 85. How many are left?
A pencil costs ₹7 and a sharpener costs ₹9. What is the total?
You have ₹100 and buy a toy for ₹64. How much money remains?
A blue rope is 45 cm and a red rope is 35 cm. What is their total length?
A table is 1 metre long. How many centimetres is that?
questions.explanation: 1 metre equals 100 centimetres.

questions.question: A bag of rice weighs 2 kg and a bag of flour weighs 3 kg. What is their total weight?
Three cups each hold 200 mL. How much do they hold altogether?
A game starts at 4:00 and ends at 4:45. How long does it last?
questions.explanation: From 4:00 to 4:45 is 45 minutes.

questions.question: A cartoon lasts 30 minutes and starts at 6:15. When does it end?
questions.explanation: Add 30 minutes to 6:15 to get 6:45.

questions.question: The thermometer reads 24°C and later reads 29°C. By how much did the temperature rise?
Each picture of a kite stands for 3 kites. What do 4 pictures stand for?
questions.explanation: 4 × 3 = 12 kites.

questions.question: A shop places 2 red balloons followed by 1 yellow balloon, repeating the group. What colour is the 6th balloon?
questions.explanation: The repeating group is red, red, yellow; position 6 is yellow.

questions.question: A ball rolls down a ramp. Which shape best describes it?
questions.explanation: A ball is shaped like a sphere.

questions.question: There are 6 bags with 4 oranges in each. How many oranges are there?
questions.explanation: 6 groups of 4 make 24.

questions.question: A child buys a ₹25 toy and a ₹15 snack. What is the total cost?
A ribbon is 90 cm long. 25 cm is cut off. How much remains?
A pumpkin weighs 4 kg. A melon weighs 2 kg. How much heavier is the pumpkin?
A jug has 1 litre of water. Half a litre is poured out. How much remains?
questions.explanation: 1 litre is 1,000 mL; half remains: 500 mL.

questions.question: School begins at 8:00 a.m. and the first lesson lasts 1 hour. When does it end?
questions.explanation: One hour after 8:00 a.m. is 9:00 a.m.

questions.question: It is 18°C in the morning and 23°C at noon. What is the difference?
A pictograph shows 2 books for each symbol. There are 6 symbols. How many books are shown?
questions.explanation: 6 × 2 = 12 books.

questions.question: A square tile has 4 equal sides. If each side is 5 cm, what is the distance around it?
A baker puts 8 buns on each tray. How many buns are on 5 trays?
A family buys 3 tickets at ₹85 each and pays with ₹300. How much change do they receive?
A school assembly starts at 8:40 a.m. and lasts 35 minutes. At what time does it end?
questions.explanation: 20 minutes takes the time to 9:00; 15 more minutes makes 9:15.

questions.question: A path is 2 km 300 m long. A student walks 750 m. How much remains?
A fruit basket weighs 1 kg 600 g. Another basket weighs 900 g. What is their total weight?
A bottle contains 1 litre 200 mL. How many millilitres is that?
questions.explanation: 1 litre is 1,000 mL; add 200 mL to get 1,200 mL.

questions.question: The room temperature rises from 21°C to 29°C. By how many degrees does it rise?
questions.explanation: 29 − 21 = 8 degrees Celsius.

questions.question: A farmer has 235 mangoes and sells 118. How many remain?
A pencil is 16 cm long. A ruler is 14 cm longer. How long is the ruler?
A child has ₹75 and spends ₹28. How much is left?
A pictograph uses one star for 3 toys. How many toys do 8 stars represent?
A four-digit number has 3 thousands, 2 hundreds, and the same digit in its tens and ones places. It is greater than 3,260 but less than 3,270. Which number could it be?
questions.explanation: The tens and ones digits must match. 3,266 is between 3,250 and 3,280.

questions.question: A school has 4 boxes with 125 pencils each. It gives 175 pencils to students. How many pencils remain?
A cake is cut into 12 equal slices. Riya eats one-third and Arun eats one-quarter of the whole cake. How many slices remain?
questions.explanation: One-third of 12 is 4 and one-quarter is 3; 12 − 4 − 3 = 5.

questions.question: A number machine adds 5 and then doubles the result. What comes out when 7 is put in?
questions.explanation: 7 + 5 = 12; double 12 to get 24.

questions.question: A 4 m ribbon is cut into pieces of 75 cm each. How many full pieces can be made, and how much ribbon remains?
questions.explanation: 400 cm ÷ 75 cm gives 5 full pieces (375 cm) with 25 cm left.

questions.question: A class has 32 pupils. One-fourth choose drawing, one-half choose music and the rest choose chess. How many choose chess?
questions.explanation: One-fourth of 32 is 8; one-half is 16; 32 − 8 − 16 = 8.

questions.question: A train leaves at 10:35 a.m. and takes 1 hour 45 minutes. At what time does it arrive?
questions.explanation: Add 1 hour to get 11:35, then 45 minutes to reach 12:20.

questions.question: A notebook costs ₹36. A shop offers 3 notebooks for ₹100. How much is saved compared with buying them separately?
questions.explanation: Three separate notebooks cost ₹108; ₹108 − ₹100 = ₹8 saved.

questions.question: A rectangle is 7 cm long and 5 cm wide. A square has the same perimeter. What is the side of the square?
questions.explanation: Rectangle perimeter is 2 × (7 + 5) = 24 cm; each square side is 24 ÷ 4 = 6 cm.

questions.question: A 2-litre jug is full. A family pours out 3 cups of 250 mL each. How much remains?
questions.explanation: Three cups use 750 mL; 2,000 − 750 = 1,250 mL.

questions.question: Use the digits 2, 0, 4 and 7 once each. What is the smallest four-digit even number?
questions.explanation: The smallest valid arrangement with an even last digit is 2,074.

questions.question: A farmer packs 7 baskets with 24 mangoes each. He sells 95 mangoes. How many are left?
A strip is divided into 8 equal parts. 3 parts are blue and 2 are red. What fraction is neither blue nor red?
questions.explanation: Eight parts minus 3 blue and 2 red leaves 3 parts: 3/8.

questions.question: The pattern is 1, 4, 9, 16, 25. Which number comes next?
questions.explanation: These are square numbers: 1², 2², 3², 4², 5²; next is 6² = 36.

questions.question: A square garden has a perimeter of 36 metres. What is the length of one side?
questions.explanation: A square has four equal sides; 36 ÷ 4 = 9 m.

questions.question: A parcel weighs 2 kg 750 g. Another parcel is 1 kg 500 g heavier. What is the second parcel's weight?
At sunrise it is 16°C. By noon it rises 9°C, then falls 4°C by evening. What is the evening temperature?
A pictograph uses one star for 5 children. How many stars are needed to show 35 children?
questions.explanation: 35 ÷ 5 = 7 stars.

questions.question: A family travels 125 km on Saturday and twice that distance on Sunday. How far do they travel altogether?
Three equal squares are joined edge-to-edge in a straight row. How many unit-length edge segments make up the outside boundary?
questions.explanation: The outline is a 3-by-1 rectangle: 3 + 1 + 3 + 1 = 8 unit edges.

questions.question: The sum of two numbers is 650. One number is 275. What is the difference between the two numbers?
questions.explanation: The other number is 650 − 275 = 375; the difference is 375 − 275 = 100.

questions.question: A school buys 9 packs of 18 markers. It shares them equally among 6 classes. How many markers does each class get?
A jug is three-quarters full and contains 900 mL. What is the jug's full capacity?
questions.explanation: If 3/4 is 900 mL, then 1/4 is 300 mL and the whole is 1,200 mL.

questions.question: A toy and a book cost ₹275 together. The toy costs ₹35 more than the book. What does the book cost?
questions.explanation: Subtract the extra ₹35: 275 − 35 = 240; half is ₹120.

questions.question: A clock is 20 minutes slow. It shows 3:15. What is the correct time?
questions.explanation: A slow clock shows a time earlier than the correct time; add 20 minutes.

questions.question: A water drum holds 15 litres. It is filled using a 750 mL jug. How many full jugs are needed?
A tile design repeats 2 blue tiles and 1 yellow tile. What colour is tile number 20?
questions.explanation: Every third tile is yellow. 20 leaves remainder 2 when divided by 3, so it is blue.

questions.question: A rectangle is made from 2 identical squares side by side. Each square has a perimeter of 20 cm. What is the rectangle's perimeter?
questions.explanation: Each square side is 5 cm; the rectangle is 10 cm by 5 cm, so perimeter = 30 cm.

questions.question: A survey has 48 votes. Three-eighths are for swimming. How many votes are for swimming?
questions.explanation: One-eighth of 48 is 6; three-eighths is 3 × 6 = 18.

questions.question: A fruit seller has 240 oranges. He packs 8 oranges in each bag and sells 17 bags. How many oranges remain?
A shop has 9 trays with 18 cups on each tray. It sells 47 cups. How many cups remain?
A box has 24 counters. One-third are red and one-quarter are blue. How many are neither red nor blue?
questions.explanation: One-third of 24 is 8; one-quarter is 6; 24 − 8 − 6 = 10.

questions.question: A rectangle has a perimeter of 34 cm. Its length is 10 cm. What is its width?
questions.explanation: 2 × (10 + width) = 34, so 10 + width = 17 and width = 7 cm.

questions.question: A library opens at 9:30 a.m. and closes at 4:15 p.m. How long is it open?
questions.explanation: From 9:30 to 4:00 is 6 hours 30 minutes; add 15 minutes.

questions.question: A four-digit number has 4 thousands and 6 hundreds. Its ones digit is 3 greater than its tens digit. Which option could be the number?
questions.explanation: In 4,636, the tens digit is 3 and the ones digit is 6, so the ones digit is 3 greater.

questions.question: A school buys 7 packs of 16 notebooks and shares them equally among 4 classes. How many notebooks does each class receive?
A jug contains 1 litre 800 mL of juice. It is poured into 6 equal cups. How much juice is in each cup?
